sentences.text:
Rufeja Bibi @ Ulfejan Bibi vs Unknown on 19 January, 2023
19.12.2022.
33. Ct.No.28 as (Rejected) C.R.M. (Db) 228 of 2023 In Re:- An application for bail under Section
439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Paikar P.S. Case No.166 of 2022 dated
24.07.2022 under Sections 498A/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code and adding Sections 304A/302
of the Indian Penal Code and charge sheet submitted under Sections 498A/302/304B/34 of the
Indian Penal Code.

In the matter of : Rufeja Bibi @ Ulfejan Bibi.
... Petitioner.
Mr. Bitasok Banerjee.
...for the Petitioner.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. P.P., Mr. Aniket Mitra.
...for the State.
Petitioner is in custody for 172 days.
It is contended she has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
We have considered the materials on record.
Dying declaration of the victim has implicated the petitioner along with others in the incident.
In view of the aforesaid materials on record and the gravity of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail at this stage.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta,J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
